description: Tropical equinox and solstice instants. Directly gates the tropical_seasons migration deferred in docs/engine-boundary-audit.md section 4.

source.notes: UNPOPULATED. Do not fill from this engine's own output - that would be a regression baseline, and the runner rejects it. Needs a published almanac, observatory table, or an authority the maintainer designates.

tolerance.rationale: Observatory-published equinox instants are given to the minute or better. 60 s is far tighter than the ~8 s difference between the current Meeus series and Swiss Ephemeris, so this dataset can adjudicate between them rather than merely tolerate both.

todo: HIGHEST PRIORITY. Needs equinox/solstice instants for a handful of years from an observatory source (USNO, IMCCE) - explicit approval required before fetching. Until this exists the tropical_seasons migration cannot be verified against anything except the implementation it would replace.
